title: Keto-Friendly Festive Thai Yeasty, Cheese-Pull Dough Tom-Yum
description: A keto-friendly and festive twist on traditional Thai Tom-Yum soup, featuring a yeast-based dough that pulls like cheesy bread but is low-carb and high in fat.
instructions: Combine yeast, almond flour, coconut oil, cheese, egg, and broth mix in a mixing bowl and knead the dough for 10 minutes until it forms a sticky ball.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until it has doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the dough balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each ball.
Bake the dough in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until it is golden brown and puffed.
While the dough is baking, combine fish sauce, lime juice, and Tom-Yum broth mix in a saucepan and bring it to a simmer over medium heat.
Remove the dough from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing it into rounds.
Serve the cheesy dough rounds with the Tom-Yum broth sauce spooned over the top and garnished with sliced fresh cilantro.
